llama_cpp_29092_check.leak_probe: tmp/gdn_leak/leak_probe.py: 12 documents in disjoint invented vocabularies behind one instruction prefix, /completion, temperature 0, seed 7; 0-7 each in a fresh slot, then 1..11, 0, 3, 1 in one used slot: every warm answer with a fresh reference byte-identical, no word of another document in any; 8 slots q8_0 512K MTP off, and MTP on
llama_cpp_29092_check.recurrent_state: a conversation's recurrent state after coming back into a slot hashes the same whatever used the slot in between
llama_cpp_29092_check.bug_found: restored conversations had rows zeroed: zero_cells (0.1.17) queues the zeroing of freed cells on the graphs' stream, the restore writes rows with ggml_backend_tensor_set on another; in the case found the last attention layer's V for cells 3840..4429 of a 4536-cell conversation came back zero (318 KB of the 191 MB state), whichever conversation had used the slot. Fixed by apply_restore_wait_035: whole-state hash as it left == as it came back (tmp/gdn_leak/check_restore_hashes.py)
llama_cpp_29092_check.expected_difference: the disk store splits a conversation's runs at the longest common prefix with stored runs and keeps the shared part once; a conversation restored from disk gets those cells as the first conversation computed them (same tokens, another batch shape): in the case found one cell's K/V in the last two attention layers differed by one quantization step, which flipped a late token at temperature 0
